name: Subhashri
bio: Subhashri is an Indian film actress in south cinema. She is the sister of south actress Malashri. She was noted for roles in films like Gentleman, Muthu, Pedarayudu and Kadhalan.

credits.title: Bhanda Alla Bahaddur
credits.overview: Following a misunderstanding, Krishna's grandfather throws him out of the house. His life takes a huge turn when he moves to the town and gets married to a rich girl.

credits.title: Circle Inspector
credits.overview: Ashok and his wife Arundhati are honest police officers who fight for justice. Trouble ensues when Arundhati reopens a case, and the culprit comes after her.

credits.title: Pattanakke Banda Putta
credits.overview: Putta, an orphan, encounters his birth father after ages and comes to the city with him. But he ends up meeting his step-brothers, who had attempted to misbehave with his girlfriend.

credits.title: Minor Mappillai
credits.overview: Minor Mappillai (Tamil: மைனர் மாப்பிள்ளை) is a 1996 Tamil comedy film starring Ajith Kumar and Ranjith in the leading roles. The pair play small-time crooks who hook up with a rags-to-riches businessman, played by Vadivelu, to take revenge on a millionaire, played by Srividya.

credits.title: Maa Aavida Collector
credits.overview: An illiterate Raja marries an educated Indira who, with the help of Raja, becomes a collector. However, Indira's mother is against the marriage and starts creating problems in their relationship.

credits.title: Ooha
credits.overview: A young man falls in love with the girl of his dreams. However, he has to face many challenges while trying to win her over and must overcome them all.

credits.title: Muthu
credits.overview: The story concerns Muthu, a charismatic, well-respected and loyal servant and charioteer of Raja Malayasimman, a wealthy zamindar. credits.title: Pedarayudu
credits.overview: Pedarayudu, the eldest brother, sits on an ancestral throne that is cursed and whoever delivers a wrong verdict dies. However, things take a turn after his youngest brother is accused of murder.

credits.title: Punya Bhoomi Naa Desam
credits.overview: A lazy, alcoholic youngster is thrown out of his village at a very young age by his mother for disobeying her orders. He meets a journalist who urges him to mete out justice to those in need of it.

credits.title: Pokiri Raja
credits.overview: Pokiri Raja is a 1995 Telugu film directed by Kodandarami Reddy. The film stars Venkatesh, Roja Selvamani, Ali and Shubha in lead roles.

credits.title: Pudhiya Mannargal
credits.overview: Two men end up falling for the same woman, but which one will she choose?

credits.title: Kanmani
credits.overview: Once good friends, Gayatri, a leading lawyer, and inspector Rajalakshmi become sworn enemies. Although Gayatri's brother, Raja, loves Rajalakshmi's daughter, she fixes his marriage elsewhere.

credits.title: Gangmaster
credits.overview: Gangmaster is a 1994 Telugu film directed by B. Gopal. It has music composed by A. R. Rahman. It was dubbed into Tamil with the title Manitha Manitha. The film was a remake of Hindi film Sir.

credits.title: Navibbaru Namagibbaru
credits.overview: In a bid to turn their lives around, two lookalikes, who have different personalities, switch places to find true love in their partners.

credits.title: Gentleman
credits.overview: Kicha is a modern-day Robin Hood, who along with his friend, Mani, steals from the rich to aid the poor. In society, he is a respected man who runs a small business.

credits.title: Enga Thambi
credits.overview: Pichumani and Indu are in love but Indu's uncle, Dinakar, is against their relationship. He plots against Pichumani and sends him to jail. Indu and a lawyer start investigating in order to help Pichu.
